blockers.finding: no strict-SOM mode exists to run and no labels exist to score it against, so this mode is marked rather than approximated

evidence.detail: https://nerdd.univie.ac.at/api/modules/gloryx exposes 1 job parameter(s) ['metabolism_phase'] and 0 of 16 result properties name a site
GLORYx's own README names site-of-metabolism only as the internal FAME 3 component; it documents no strict mode, threshold or SOM flag
results/what_each_arm_returns.json records GLORYx and MetaTox as naming no site
paper2/si.tex states this corpus carries no site-of-metabolism labels, so the mode could not be scored even if it could be run

blockers.finding: GLORYxR cannot be run: no implementation and no featuriser is available in this repository, on this machine, or in the delivered archive

evidence.detail: the delivered archive holds 11 entries, all of them .joblib models: no code, no featuriser
gloryxr, gloryx and glory_x are not importable here, and a scoped search of the usual checkout locations found no source tree
scripts/typed_edit/gloryx_via_service.py records that GLORYxR's production model dumps are 'to be published' and its documentation's Zenodo link is a literal TODO
the single model declares n_features_in_=5014 against 5006 for the rule models: two featurisations, neither of them present

blockers.finding: the delivered models were pickled by scikit-learn 1.9.0 while this environment has 1.7.2; newer-to-older is unsupported, so their predictions could not be trusted here even if code existed

evidence.detail: every model warns 'unpickle ... from version 1.9.0'; the installed version is 1.7.2
scikit-learn 1.9.0 and 1.9.1 are published on PyPI and require Python >= 3.11; this interpreter is 3.10.8, whose ceiling is 1.7.2

blockers.finding: two of the delivered models are byte-identical under different names, so they cannot be treated as distinct arms without asking the sender

evidence.detail: 'CYP rules from GLORY (phase 1).joblib' and 'Phase 1 SyGMa rules.joblib' both hash to 2c186eb6f3e35fa99885d5ea96d706de1f17300b4cecb96c33d4e942bb57a1dc
